name: gigamail
description: Mail and calendar for your AI agent: an MCP server on your real mailbox (Microsoft 365 or IMAP) with out-of-band human approval on every send, delete and calendar write.

interface.shortDescription: Your real inbox and calendar for your agent, with a human on the send button.
interface.longDescription: GigaMail exposes the user's real mailboxes (Microsoft 365 via Graph, or any IMAP provider) and calendar as 24 typed MCP tools. Reading, searching, attachment text, sender history, free-slot computation and drafting are free; send, reply, delete and calendar writes return an inert request id and execute only after a human approves out of band, from the desktop console or CLI, with the arguments stored at request time. Mail content is treated as data, never as instructions.
capabilities: Read, search and triage mail across Microsoft 365 and IMAP accounts
Extract attachment text (PDF, DOCX, XLSX) without passing binaries to the model
Draft replies from the account's identity and knowledge files
Compute free calendar slots and manage events
Out-of-band human approval for send, reply, delete and calendar writes
